title: View a display's status and time offline
summary: Filter the Displays & Devices list to offline screens, see how long each has been offline, and open a display's details to diagnose it.
bodyMd:
The Status column in Displays & Devices shows whether each screen is online, and how long any offline screen has been down. Check it every morning before stores open: an offline display cannot play campaigns or support personalised experiences, and a group of displays offline for the same period usually points to a hardware, network or operating-system fault.

Before you begin

  • An HQ Admin account.

Steps

  1. In the left navigation, select Displays & Devices.
  2. In the Status column header, open the filter and choose Offline.
  3. To narrow the list to screens that have been offline for a given period, choose a period in the same filter, for example 30 Days.
  4. Read the count at the top of the list. It shows how many displays have been offline for the selected period.
  5. To see exactly how long an individual display has been offline, hover over its red status icon.
  6. To investigate a display, select its Name. The detail page opens on its Display Details tab and shows its Status at the top right.

Verify it worked

The list shows only offline displays, with a count for the chosen period, and hovering a status icon shows the time offline.

What to check on the detail page

Tab or fieldWhat it tells you
Active PlaylistWhich playlist the display is on, and therefore which campaigns it supports
Asset ID, Device Serial NumberIdentifiers for troubleshooting the device in your MDM/CDM
Public IP AddressThe store's connection address, for diagnosing connectivity and IP allow-lists
Unique Device IDIdentifier used to authenticate the device with other platforms
Campaign Playback tabWhich campaigns have played and which interactions were triggered
Device Status tabHistory of offline periods, disconnections and configuration changes
